about_the_game:
My Car My Life is a 2D drag racing game with realistic physics, detailed mechanics, and a 100% Brazilian vibe.


Build, tune, and race cars that marked generations in Brazil, from the ’70s to the 2015s.

The focus here is on the passion of building your project from scratch! the customization system is technical and demands attention, every engine has its ideal combos, and the game rewards those who know their stuff.

You also get the NoguiinTech, a hub inspired by FuelTech, where you can adjust ignition, injection, fuel pressure, lambda readings, and more — all in real time.

In career mode, you’ll face 12 unique opponents, each with their own style and tuned car. Plus, compete in seasonal championships (spring, summer, fall, winter) with categories for both naturally aspirated and turbo engines.

There are three different tracks to race on:

  • Abandoned Street

  • Largados Racetrack

  • Ignorant Highway

Outside the tracks, there’s a Bar with three minigames where you can try your luck and earn extra cash to invest in your car.

And the engine sounds? They’re a show on their own. Each car has its own unique and realistic roar, both at idle and full throttle.

If you’re into real drag racing, building projects, and that raw Brazilian car culture vibe, this game is for you.

short_description: Build the car of your dreams to compete in intense drag races, featuring detailed mechanics, advanced customization, and realistic physics. Tune every part of the engine, control the revs with precision, and win through reaction and skill.
